gates.blocker: Unblocked 2026-10-11 05:53 UTC. The expired sk_test key found on 2026-10-10 (PaymentReconciliationService logged 'Expired API Key provided ... code: api_key_expired' on every scheduled run) was rotated and the API container recreated with docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d --force-recreate app. Verified by production audit row id=87 at 2026-10-11 05:53:48, 'Checked 0 Stripe intents; 0 issue(s)': audit() is only reached after fetchRecentIntents() returns, so the row proves the Stripe call authenticated. Container healthy, Flyway 23 validated, zero reconciliation failures since boot. STRIPE_PAYMENT LEGS NOW VERIFIED LIVE 2026-10-11, using the production container's own rotated key against Stripe's TEST API via StripeLifecycleTest (the exact StripeService methods the backend calls): create customer -> SetupIntent -> attach pm_card_visa (read back 4242/visa) -> Express Connect account + onboarding link -> authorize 15000 cad hold (requires_capture) -> capture (succeeded) -> authorize 9000 cad -> release (canceled, never charged). 3 tests, 0 failures, 0 skipped. Webhooks verified live too: Stripe delivered payment_intent.succeeded and payment_intent.canceled to https://api.rapidstylers.ca/rapid_stylers/stripe/webhook and the backend signature-verified and processed them, logging 'Stripe webhook no-match: ... no booking for payment intent' (correct: the e2e intents have no local appointment). NEW DEFECT FOUND AND FIXED, NOT YET DEPLOYED: PaymentReconciliationService.fetchRecentIntents() built its lookback with a bare .setCreated(sinceEpoch), which Stripe treats as an EXACT-second match, not a lower bound, so every scheduled run fetched 0 intents and reported '0 issue(s)' while examining nothing. The earlier claim that 'Checked 0 Stripe intents' was expected because the account had no intents in the window is disproven: the account has 52 intents inside 72h, all created before the fix. Fixed to created[gte] with a regression test asserting the range shape; verified live: old params 0 intents, new params 52. Payment package 1218 tests, 0 failures. The fix WAS DEPLOYED via backend CI: Backend CI/CD run on backend main commit 9ecaf5e0 (which contains 28a94db, the gte-range fix) completed with Backend tests, Secret scan (gitleaks) and Deploy to VPS all green on 2026-10-12. VERIFIED 2026-10-11/12: (a) Backend provider-leg suite re-run on 9ecaf5e0: 173 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors across StripeWebhookLogTest, WebhookSignatureTest, RefundServiceTest, RefundReviewServiceTest, DisputeWebhookTest, ConnectWebhookTest, PayoutReleaseServiceTest, PayoutReversalServiceTest, PayoutSummaryTest, PaymentReconciliationServiceTest, CommissionSnapshotTest, AdminConnectStatusTest, PlatformSettingsTest, PromotionTest, OtpSecurityTest, PasswordResetOtpVerificationTest, PasswordResetJourneyTest, SignupUploadPassLifetimeTest, UploadOwnershipTest, CloudinaryControllerTest, CloudinaryServiceTest, ImageReclaimServiceTest. (b) CI SECRET SCAN PASSES for both candidates: Frontend CI gitleaks job green on dev de8a618 and main 0888118; backend Secret scan (gitleaks) green on dev/main 9ecaf5e0. Local full-history gitleaks scans agree: frontend 0 findings in history and worktree; backend 3 history findings, all verified false positives (a test idempotency-key fixture in BookingRetriesTest, a since-deleted JwtUtilTest fixture, and postmortem doc prose); the only worktree hits in either repo are the ignored local .env files. (c) REAL OTP DELIVERY CONFIRMED via the Resend API log: 'RapidStylers Verification Code' emails status=delivered (multiple, 2026-10-11 21:23 through 2026-10-12 02:10 UTC), 'Welcome to RapidStylers' delivered, reconciliation digests sent to the admin mailbox. (d) GOOGLE ADDRESS SUGGESTIONS VERIFIED LIVE against the production API: /rapid_stylers/place_autocomplete returns real Google Places suggestions with placeIds (e.g. '17 Street Southwest, Calgary, AB, Canada') and /place_details resolves a picked placeId to a parsed address with coordinates; both return 401 without the shared key. (e) UPLOAD OWNERSHIP DENIAL VERIFIED LIVE: /get_upload_signature and /delete_cloudinary_image both refuse anonymous callers ('Authorized role required'; 401 with no key); Cloudinary credentials verified with a read-only Admin API list against the real cloud. Backend media tests (UploadOwnershipTest 4, CloudinaryControllerTest 9, CloudinaryServiceTest 8, ImageReclaimServiceTest 13) all pass. STILL REMAINING FOR THIS GATE: refunds and disputes exercised end-to-end through the running app against a live Stripe test booking (backend unit and webhook coverage passes, and payment/cancellation legs ran live via StripeLifecycleTest, but no live refund or dispute has been driven through the app), and a photo/ID upload from the browser with real Cloudinary egress (the signature gate is verified live, but the browser upload itself is still intercepted in e2e).

gates.blocker: Partial, verified 2026-10-11. Playwright now runs five projects: desktop Chromium, iPhone Chromium, Firefox, WebKit (desktop Safari engine) and iPhone WebKit, all 30/30 passing, 150 tests across 6 maintained spec files, exit 0. The earlier record of 'Chromium 20/20, WebKit 13/17, Firefox could not launch' is superseded: Firefox launches and passes, and the 4 admin-registration WebKit failures plus the iPhone failures were real defects that are now fixed. (1) WebKit refuses to write a Blob or File into IndexedDB - the transaction aborts with 'Error preparing Blob/File data to be stored in object store' - so on Safari and iPhone the professional's photos were silently lost on every reload; photos are now stored as bytes with name and type attached, which every engine accepts, and a unit regression pins the stored shape. (2) The photo namespace was re-decided per storage call, but a document can never re-acquire a lock name it already holds, so the read and the write landed in different databases; the claim is now settled once per document and a probe across a real navigation in both engines proved the stored name is handed back after a reload. (3) The stylist Calendar laid out at 436px inside a 390px viewport - Chromium hides this because its innerWidth expands to the content while WebKit's does not - fixed by letting the month controls wrap; all nine stylist tabs now measure 390px. (4) Specs branched on the project name 'mobile', so the iPhone WebKit project silently skipped every phone-only check; they now branch on the viewport or on what is visible. (5) NEW 2026-10-12: the same suite now runs on GitHub Actions Linux runners on every dev/main push, and that surfaced two WebKit defects macOS WebKit could not see: the logo video never resumed under Linux WebKit's stricter autoplay/history-restoration policy (fixed in de8a618 by resuming on scroll after a real pointer interaction), and the landing full-page screenshot exceeded WebKit's 32767px limit on the iPhone project (fixed by scale:'css'). Frontend CI on dev de8a618 is green: all five projects, 150/150, on both macOS locally and Linux CI. STILL BLOCKING SIGN-OFF: every run intercepts external traffic with fixtures, so this is engine coverage, not live coverage. Section 3 still requires real installed Safari and Firefox and a physical iPhone against the live site, plus production performance measurements, before the gate can close.
gates.requirement: Supported Safari and Firefox flows are verified in addition to Chromium.
